Nations Quake Rank Custom Map League was held (mostly) during [[NQR Season 4]]. By the time of [[NQR Season 5]] the CMT maps became part of the main league and have been very often since. This league was to test the relatively new CMT maps in serious [[4on4]] play. The map pool consisted of [[CMT1]], [[CMT2]], [[CMT3]], [[CMT4]] and [[CMT5]].
